🏙️ Life Roleplay – Modern Urban City

Step into a spacious modern city built for smooth exploration and immersive roleplay. The map features a wide main road, clean intersections, connected side streets, organized sidewalks, and simple modern street lighting that creates a realistic urban feel. A stylish residential area includes a contemporary house with a private driveway, parking space, greenery, outdoor living areas, and subtle fencing for a clean and polished look.

Across the road, a large modern building stands out with connected sections, clear entrances, paved walkways, and an open central area that adds depth and realism to the environment. The city is designed with balanced spacing, open areas, parking zones, and green spaces to keep the layout practical, organized, and visually appealing.

The overall atmosphere is modern, realistic, clean, and spacious — perfect for players who enjoy urban roleplay in a polished and well-designed city environment.
